correctness.rationale: The exact stationary pair hierarchy has boundary values 1 and alternating reset source r(-1)^n. Its unique finite solution and bounded infinite solution give the claimed rational/exponential profiles. Strict decrease of the hyperbolic ratio in r proves one root per odd distance, and decrease with distance and finite-image correction prove nested thresholds and finite-ring shifts. The root identity e^{-nκ/2}=sinh(κ/2) gives algebraic polynomial and Lambert W asymptotics. Periodization gives the full Fourier response. Independently constructed full CTMC generators for N=4,6,8, threshold brackets and Fourier values passed 400 assertion groups; numerics were not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The problem has a natural physical competition: zero-temperature ferromagnetic coarsening versus recurrent global antiferromagnetic patterns. Rather than a cherry-picked threshold, the theorem classifies every odd/even spatial correlation on every even ring and the infinite chain. Finite-volume threshold shifts, a sharp logarithmically enhanced sign front and simultaneous Bragg/diffuse structure permit comparisons across scales and identify where local alignment can coexist with globally staggered order. Correlation zeros are not misrepresented as thermodynamic phase transitions.
